patterns.name: Bottleneck / Capacity-Limited Flow
patterns.claim: System throughput is controlled by a scarce capacity constraint, so interventions should target the bottleneck rather than non-limiting parts.
composition_laws: flow routed through bottleneck capacity determines output throughput
transfer_predictions: A valid bottleneck transfer should identify the limiting resource and predict that relieving it improves throughput more than optimizing non-bottleneck steps.

patterns.name: Conservation / Balance-Preserving Transformation
patterns.claim: A transformation is valid only when a conserved quantity or budget remains balanced before and after the state change.
composition_laws: state transformation plus balance check preserves the conserved quantity
transfer_predictions: A valid conservation transfer should expose the conserved quantity and a before/after balance check.

patterns.name: Controlled Intervention / A-B Falsification
patterns.claim: Test one intervention against a matched control before promoting a new assumption.
composition_laws: one intervention plus matched control identifies causal effect
transfer_predictions: A candidate with control-variable context should declare trigger and control rows before acceptance.

patterns.name: Counterexample-Guided Claim Refinement
patterns.claim: Use an adversarial counterexample to falsify an overbroad claim, then narrow or patch the claim with a guardrail.
composition_laws: counterexample falsifies claim; refined claim handles the counterexample with an explicit guardrail
transfer_predictions: A valid counterexample transfer should produce a specific failing case and a narrower claim that the same case no longer breaks.

patterns.name: Decomposition / Interface-Preserving Composition
patterns.claim: Split a root problem into bounded subproblems whose interface contracts compose back into the whole goal.
composition_laws: split problem then solve subproblems through interface contracts; composed solution recovers the root problem
transfer_predictions: A valid decomposition transfer should name subproblem interfaces and a composition check that recovers the root goal.

patterns.name: Incremental Replacement / Module Boundary Preservation
patterns.claim: Keep a working pipeline and replace one bounded module at a time with rollback.
composition_laws: preserved pipeline + one bounded replacement + rollback supports safe iteration
transfer_predictions: For high-risk system changes, structural context should prefer one-module replacement with rollback over whole-system rewrite.

patterns.name: Monotone Progress / Order-Preserving Improvement
patterns.claim: A safe iterative update should preserve an ordering or objective measure so progress does not regress.
composition_laws: monotone update preserves order and produces non-decreasing objective progress
transfer_predictions: A valid monotone-progress transfer should define the order/objective and detect any update that regresses it.

patterns.name: Negative Feedback / Equilibrium Restoration
patterns.claim: An induced response opposes an external perturbation under a constraint or stability principle.
composition_laws: perturbation induces response; response opposes perturbation
disturbance creates compensating reaction that cancels change
transfer_predictions: If the mapping is valid, an answer should identify the perturbation, induced response, and preserved constraint.

patterns.name: Residual Correction / Identity-Preserving Update
patterns.claim: Preserve a verified baseline or identity path while learning only the local delta.
composition_laws: output = identity(input) + delta(input)
zero delta recovers baseline
transfer_predictions: When a plan risks destructive overwrite, structural context should preserve the old path and apply only a local delta.

patterns.name: Signal vs Stochastic Nuisance Separation
patterns.claim: Bias estimation toward predictable structure while suppressing stochastic nuisance variation.
composition_laws: predictable structure is retained while uncorrelated nuisance is suppressed
transfer_predictions: A valid transfer should improve stable-state prediction or denoising while avoiding reconstruction of nuisance details.
